name: Open Review Cases
description: The count of review cases that are not yet in a terminal (closed) workflow state.

name: Cases by Severity
description: The distribution of open review cases grouped by severity level.

name: Missing Supporting Evidence
description: The count of currently open missing-supporting-evidence signals across tracked obligations.

name: Missed Deadline Trend
description: The count of missed-deadline signals raised per period over time, used to visualise persistence of overdue obligations.

name: Outstanding Obligations
description: The count of open action items tracking obligation follow-up whose due date has passed or is at risk of being missed.

name: Exceptions Awaiting Approval
description: The count of proposed accept-exception decisions awaiting human approval.

name: Liability Exposure Outlook
description: A hypothetical estimate of aggregate liability exposure at risk across engagements currently carrying an open conflicting-provisions signal, derived from the financial-threshold observations on record. This is a forward-looking estimate, never an observed measurement, and must not be presented as fact.

name: Critical Signals
description: The count of currently open signals at critical severity across tracked engagements.

name: Pending Decisions
description: The count of proposed decisions across tracked engagements that have not yet reached a final approved or rejected outcome.

name: Recent Review Activity
description: A rolling feed of the most recent operational events, signals, and case updates across tracked engagements.
